Only COAT MATERIAL needs radical simplification. Replace Buddy entire charcoal torso, neck, chest and all leg surfaces with broad FLAT SMOOTH gouache color planes. NO individual fur strokes, no engraving, no curls, no zigzags, no swirls. Smooth underbody margin and tail into slender natural taper without feathery tip. Body close clipped not woolly. Maintain light leg fields and tan chest markings as smooth color shapes. Keep localized beard, brows, moustache and pendant ear furniture; only there can a few strands show. Neet entire fawn body/neck/legs similarly smooth flat short-coat color fields, cream muzzle/chest marking with no projecting tufts, tiny nub. Think smooth painted ceramic dog bodies with accurate anatomy EXCEPT Buddy beard/ears naturally furnished. This is material smoothing not anatomy change. IMAGE2 is independently reviewed smooth-body finish example ONLY, do not copy its scene/poses. IMAGE3 N19 original Neet smooth coat authority, IMAGE4 B04 original Buddy clipped body/regional face furnishings authority. Images2-4 must not change target scene. Keep all owned limbs and contacts; no change in head proportions, pipe, props, settings or lighting. Whole body coats must be visually smooth flat gradient fields; remove ALL dense tiny curled engraved marks. No new objects or text. N35 not anatomy, B08 styling-only unused, B25 unavailable, B30 supplemental-rest unused; one exposure once. Generated examples not anatomy authorities.
